learn.title: Cutting a triangle
learn.body: A line drawn parallel to one side of a triangle creates a smaller triangle that is similar to the whole one. That gives a handy rule about how the other two sides are cut.

learn.title: The triangle proportionality rule
learn.body: In triangle $ABC$, let $D$ be on $AB$ and $E$ on $AC$ with $DE$ parallel to $BC$. Then $\frac{AD}{DB}=\frac{AE}{EC}$. The parallel line cuts both sides in the same ratio.

learn.title: The midsegment
learn.body: A segment joining the midpoints of two sides is parallel to the third side and exactly half as long. If the base is 14, the midsegment is 7.

learn.title: Indirect measurement
learn.body: A 2 m stick casts a 3 m shadow. A tree casts a 12 m shadow at the same time.

questions.prompt: The base of a triangle is 14. How long is the midsegment parallel to it?
questions.explanation: A midsegment is half as long as the side it is parallel to.

questions.prompt: What is true of a segment that joins the midpoints of two sides of a triangle?
choices: It is parallel to the third side
It is equal to the third side
It is perpendicular to the third side
It is twice the third side
questions.explanation: The midsegment is parallel to the third side and half its length.

questions.prompt: A 2 m stick casts a 3 m shadow. A tree casts a 15 m shadow at the same time. How tall is the tree, in metres?
A line parallel to one side of a triangle cuts the other two sides in the same \_\_.
questions.explanation: Both cut sides are divided in the same proportion.

questions.prompt: $DE\parallel BC$ with $AD=2$, $DB=2$. What does this say about $E$?
choices: $E$ is twice as far from $A$ as $D$

questions.prompt: The midsegment of a triangle is 9. How long is the side it is parallel to?
questions.explanation: The side is twice the midsegment: $2\cdot9=18$.
